table.retrieve:
SELECT invcode     = dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,    
         date        = dbo.saleledgermodified.date, 
         flatdisc    = dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc, 
			salestax    = dbo.saleledgermodified.salestax,       
         misccharges = dbo.saleledgermodified.misccharges,
			patient		= (SELECT name FROM patient WHERE patientcode=:ar_patientcode), 
			regno       = (SELECT regno FROM patient WHERE patientcode=:ar_patientcode), 
			invdiscperc = dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc, 
			doctype = Case dbo.saleledgermodified.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
         dbo.accounts.name, 
         amount =  Sum ( dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty * dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice),    
			itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice - dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty  * dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc),2)), 2),    
    		invdiscpercvalue = Sum (Round( dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice  - dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc /100) ,
			salesman = dbo.users.username ,
    		totaldiscount= Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice - dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty  * dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice  - dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc /100), 2) + dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc,
			difference= Sum ( dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty * dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice) - sum(Round(saledetailmodified.packprice/ISNULL(saledetailmodified.packunits ,1),2) * saledetailmodified.looseqty)

    FROM dbo.saleledgermodified, 
         dbo.saledetailmodified,   
         dbo.accounts,
			dbo.users  

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledgermodified.patientcode = :ar_patientcode ) and
			( dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetailmodified.saleinvcode ) and  
         ( dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
			( dbo.saleledgermodified.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode )and  
     	   ( dbo.saleledgermodified.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            

GROUP BY dbo.saleledgermodified.misccharges,   
         dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc,   
         dbo.saleledgermodified.date,   
         dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,   
			dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc,  
			dbo.saleledgermodified.salestax, 
			dbo.saleledgermodified.salecatcode,
			dbo.accounts.name,
			dbo.users.username
         
ORDER BY dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode ASC,   
         dbo.saleledgermodified.date ASC

objects.name: c_totalnettotal
objects.expression: Round(sum( (  amount  -  itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue -  flatdisc  +  misccharges ) for all),0)
